channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 20 sources (17 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: v1.0.0-alpha.2
item.description: OpenAI Agents SDK ships v1.0.0-alpha.2, a preview release that keeps refining the agent-building toolkit ahead of the 1.0 launch.

item.title: v0.26.0
item.description: Agents SDK 0.26.0 brings the GPT-Live demo up to version 1.1 and fixes version compatibility in the external provider example plus a Docker resource limit.
Claude Code 2.1.331 extends Code Mode to terminal sessions across four cloud platforms — Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry, and Claude on AWS — while the apps gateway gains a new OIDC group setting.

item.title: Release v0.71.1
item.description: A patch release that backports a fix into the v0.71.0 line to address an issue in that version.

item.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
item.description: Richpanel wired GPT-6 models into its support workflow, letting AI agents take over half of human support work within 30 days.

item.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
item.description: This hands-on walkthrough trains an obstacle-avoidance controller for the Microduck robot in Isaac Lab using ToF sensor data, then deploys the finished policy onto the real machine.

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
item.description: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that helps teams keep running systems protected while patches roll out.

item.title: Release v0.72.0-preview.0
item.description: Gemini CLI ships v0.72.0-preview.0, fixing nested .gitignore handling and Windows home paths, resuming the most recently active session, and adding authentication and input checks to the A2A server.

item.title: v2.4.0
item.description: OpenCode ships v2.4.0; the release notes list no specific changes, so this is a routine version bump.

item.title: v2.4.1
item.description: Open-source terminal agent OpenCode ships v2.4.1, with no detailed release notes attached this time.

item.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
item.description: DeepMind pairs multi-agent teams with formal verification to find faster quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

item.title: Your agents run for days: now Kiro CLI keeps up
item.description: Kiro CLI now handles long-running tasks, letting agents work steadily for days without dropping off.

item.title: v2.72.0 (2026-11-23)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.72.0 flags requests aimed at models Anthropic or OpenAI have already retired, and adds agent instruction overrides, realtime voice instructions, and aliased tool arguments.

item.title: v2.73.0 (2026-11-23)
item.description: Version 2.73.0 warns developers if they call a model that Anthropic or OpenAI has phased out, and refines how cached inputs are handled for OpenAI Responses.

item.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
item.description: Brazilian food-delivery platform iFood shares how it rolled out coding agents across 15,000 repositories.

item.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
item.description: Brazilian food-delivery platform iFood shares how it rolled out coding agents across 15,000 repositories.

item.title: A more tailored Google Search that's uniquely yours
item.description: Google Search's Personal Intelligence draws on Gmail, Drive and Photos to tailor results to each user.

item.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
item.description: AllenAI releases the RoboTrack benchmark and 15 million simulated point tracks, plus two point-tracking models that help robots keep following target points during grasping, pipetting, and other manipulation tasks.

item.title: Release v0.71.0
item.description: Gemini CLI ships v0.71.0 with its latest round of updates and improvements.

item.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
item.description: Google is bringing Gemini into the Warriors' fan experiences and day-to-day operations at Chase Center, showing how AI works in a live sports setting.
